## The Problem

```         
Run analysis 
↓ 
Copy figure manually 
↓ 
Paste into Word 
↓ 
Change analysis 
↓ 
Forget to update figure
```

## What Quarto Does

Quarto combines:

- Narrative text

- R code

- Figures

- Tables

Into one reproducible document.

## A Simple Workflow

```         
Data 
↓ 
Scripts 
↓ 
Quarto document 
↓ 
HTML / PDF / Word / slides
```

## What Are Parameters?

Parameterised reports

One report template can generate:

- multiple species reports

- multiple site reports

- multiple years

- multiple regions

Automatically.
